Question
========
According to Wheelan, in *Naked Statistics: Stripping the Dread from the Data?*, what is the most common cause of inaccurate polling results?

Answerlist
----------

* Biased sampling methods or poorly worded questions

* Incorrect calculations of standard errors

* Random variation in respondent answers

* Misuse of statistical software during data analysis
